description: Guardian names a relationship but not which child.
turns: Mere bete ke liye Dr. Sethi ke saath appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: Sunita is a listed guardian of Aarav and Arjun, who share a surname, a date of birth and a phone number. Authorisation is satisfied and the slot is free, so everything looks bookable; the open question is which child. A naive agent picks the first ward, or books the guardian herself.
